name: Divine Soul
summary: Sorcerers whose power comes from a divine source.

features.name: Divine Magic
features.short: Choose sorcerer spells from the cleric list too; an affinity spell.
features.summary: When you learn a sorcerer spell, you can choose it from the cleric list as well. Choose an affinity (good, evil, law, chaos or neutrality); you learn its spell, which doesn't count against your spells known.

features.name: Favored by the Gods
features.short: Add 2d4 to a failed save or missed attack.
features.summary: If you fail a saving throw or miss with an attack roll, you can roll 2d4 and add it to the total, possibly changing the outcome. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Empowered Healing
features.short: Spend 1 sorcery point to reroll healing dice.
features.summary: When you or an ally within 5 ft. rolls dice to restore hit points with a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to reroll any number of those dice once.

features.name: Otherworldly Wings
features.short: Bonus action: wings with a 30 ft. flying speed.
features.summary: As a bonus action, you manifest spectral wings (feathered or bat-like), gaining a flying speed of 30 ft. until you dismiss them.

features.name: Unearthly Recovery
features.short: Bonus action below half HP: heal half your maximum.
features.summary: As a bonus action when you have fewer than half your hit points left, you regain hit points equal to half your maximum. Once per long rest.
